claims: The 2026 NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball Tournament Selection Show was held on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The 2026 NCAA Division I Women’s Basketball Tournament Selection Show was held at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Selection Sunday for 2026 March Madness Selection was March 15, 2026.
The First Four games begin Tuesday, March 17, and Wednesday, March 18.
The 2026 men's tournament top seeds were announced as Duke, Arizona, Michigan, and Florida.
The full 68-team field was confirmed during the broadcast.
